head.t: Macmillan lends support to UK prostate cancer data project
head.x: Prostate Progress, a data-powered project to find better tests, treatments and care for prostate cancer, is expanding through an alliance with Macmillan.

head.t: Obesity & Weight Management Alliance expands 2027 conference programme across UK and Ireland
head.x: The Obesity & Weight Management Alliance anticipate that they will receive sponsorship from pharmaceutical companies and MedTech organisations for the 2027 conferences.
